description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kotakedeniya, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District  -  Cad. Map No. 320238
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and title registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
